description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for the 'cat' modifier, which concatenates multiple parameters into a single string expression used in Smarty templates. It contains a single function responsible for generating the compiled code for the 'cat' modifier.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_cat
methods.description: Generates compiled code that concatenates multiple parameters into a single expression for Smarty templates using parentheses and the ').(' delimiter.
